findings.reason: the move set and the done-when's grep must be extended to `_attr`, `_class_list`, `_element_id` and `_heading_open_tag_with_id`, or the intended module boundary is not reached and the guard that is meant to prove it reports success anyway.
findings.text: §17 names nine symbols as "the parser's input today" and asserts "all become part of `reckon/_plan_html.py`, so the parser imports nothing private from the store", but the nine depend on four further helpers that §17 does not name and that live only in `reckon/_store.py`: `_class_list` (`_store.py:824`, used by `_is_structural_boundary` at 840 and `_landed_card_span` at 1010), and `_attr` (812), `_element_id` (829) and `_heading_open_tag_with_id` (845), used by `_section_heading`/`_wrapper_section_heading`. Moving only the nine leaves `_plan_html.py` importing private names from `_store.py`, which is the coupling §17 exists to remove, and the done-when ("grep those nine names in `reckon/_store.py` and requires none") passes while the coupling survives.

rubric_items.deep_module: a finding — §17 aims to make `reckon/_plan_html.py` the one owner of section recognition, but its enumerated move set is incomplete, so the module does not reach the boundary the section claims.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — each proposed consolidation names the owner to extend rather than forking it: `landed_section_ids` is re-homed, not doubled (§17); `promotion._plan_remaining_sections` is deleted and promotion calls the extended `roadmap.implementable_sections` (§18); the `c-run-` constant is hoisted to one owner (§18); the testimony of `evidence._section_key` and `ledger.normalize_section` is preserved with stated reasons (§16).
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — with `public_definitions` 1476, `cli_options` 317, `mcp_views` 33, `refusal_families` 23, only §17 adds surface: one public definition, `plan_headings`, which the section names and accounts for ("the net is one", with `landed_section_ids` retired from `reckon/_store.py` under the same name); §16 and §18 add none and say so, and §16 reuses the existing `plan-review-missing` family rather than adding a refusal family.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan searched the package it extends and cites the mechanism for each move: §17 consolidates onto the existing `_StructuredSectionSpanParser` in `reckon/_plan_html.py`, §16 onto `plan_fingerprint`/`_fingerprint_forms` in `reckon/crew/plan_review.py`, §18 onto `roadmap.implementable_sections`; every named owner file exists at the head and holds the named symbols.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the sections that could have been thin wrappers justify themselves in their own text: §16 states the coverage predicate "is not a wrapper over the review reader" and separates the two join shapes; §18 explains why neither `doccheck._implementable_section_ids` nor `metadata_index` is folded onto the extended owner.
